title: Sunday on Anderson Square
subtitle: The times officials gave for the ICE shooting in north Austin and what followed
alt: Timeline of the September 20, 2026 shooting of a man by an Immigration and Customs Enforcement officer in north Austin. At about 12:50 p.m. the Texas Department of Public Safety says it was asked to help immigration officers with a vehicle pursuit near Anderson Square and Research Boulevard. At 12:56 p.m. Austin-Travis County Emergency Medical Services was notified of a shooting in the 8000 block of Anderson Square. Medics arrived about three and a half minutes later and found a man with a gunshot wound to the torso. He was taken to a trauma center within nine minutes of their arrival, in serious but stable condition. At 4 p.m. city leaders held a news conference and said the Austin Police Department was not involved in the shooting. At about 4:30 p.m. a hospital attorney told his lawyer he had been released into federal immigration custody.
source: Texas Department of Public Safety and Austin-Travis County EMS accounts, via KXAN and FOX 7 Austin
